title: Apple Watch HRV not updating: what to check before interpreting stress
angle: Troubleshooting missing or stale readings, separate from interpreting an actual measurement. Explain timestamps, watch fit, available Health data and app permissions. Do not promise continuous HRV sampling or suggest changing medical features to force readings.

title: Apple Health permissions for stress apps: what access means
angle: Explain read versus write permissions, revoking access and checking the timestamp of available data. Do not invent Cortisol+ menu labels or claim all data stays on-device; defer to the actual privacy and methodology pages.

title: Why stress scores differ between apps
primaryKeyword: why stress scores differ between apps
angle: Explain differences in inputs, measurement timing and scoring definitions. Use the published Cortisol+ method only as one documented example. Do not invent head-to-head testing, competitors' formulas, universal cutoffs or clinical accuracy.

title: How to keep a stress journal alongside wearable data
angle: A practical guide to recording sleep, routine, context and timestamps using the existing free journal. Explain that observing an association does not establish causation and neither a journal nor a wellness score measures cortisol. No treatment plan or promised health outcome.
